title: Normalized affine self-Tor coordinates agree on unit images of ideal wedges
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], $n\in\mathbf N$, $B=i_*\mathcal O_Z$, $Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}B[0])$ for the fixed derived tensor [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], $N=i^*\ker(i)$ [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and $E=\bigwedge^n N$ [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. For each affine open $U$ of $Y$, put $A_U=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I_U=i.\mathrm{ker}.\mathrm{ideal}(U)$, $O_U=i^{-1}U$, and let $T_U$ be associated-sheaf formation on $\operatorname{Spec}(A_U)$ followed by affine chart restriction, open pushforward, and tensor pullback by $i$. Let $c_U$ be the normalized comparison from the exterior conormal module to $\operatorname{Tor}^{A_U}_n(A_U/I_U,A_U/I_U)$ [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. There exist families of isomorphisms s_U:E|O_U ≅ T_U(source(c_U))|O_U and t_U:T_U(target(c_U))|O_U ≅ Q|O_U. Write φ_U=s_U T_U(c_U) t_U. Let η:ker(i) → i_*i*ker(i) be the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For every nested pair of ambient affine opens V⊆U and every tuple b:Fin(n)→Γ(V,ker(i)), the component of φ_U over O_V and the top component of φ_V have equal values on the wedge of the sections η_V(b_j) of N over O_V. This asserts equality only for wedges of actual ideal sections on the whole affine chart; it makes no assertion about arbitrary conormal sections on a subopen.

proof.text: Obtain shared source and target coordinates satisfying the normalized principal-localization equation for restrictions of ideal tuples defined on the larger affine chart.

The ideal module is the kernel of the structure-module map to the closed-subscheme pushforward. Structure modules are quasi-coherent, as is their closed pushforward; kernels preserve quasi-coherence. On V=D(f) in U apply the affine denominator theorem to each ideal section b_j of V, obtaining a_j on U and m_j with a_j|V=f^m_j b_j. The pullback unit is linear through i.app(V), so its images satisfy the same equation. The image of f|V in O_Z(i^-1 V) is a unit. Express each unit image of b_j as its inverse m_j-th power times the unit image of a_j|V. Exterior multilinearity extracts the product of these inverse powers. Linearity of the two chart maps and the equation from the preceding step therefore give agreement for every ideal tuple on a principal open.

For arbitrary affine V⊆U and an ideal tuple on V, at each point of i^-1 V use Mathlib exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter to find one open W that is principal in both U and V. Restrict the tuple from V to W. Naturality of the pullback unit and the exterior-sheafification unit identifies its wedge with restriction of the original wedge. Naturality of each chart map identifies restriction of its output with its component over i^-1 W. Apply the preceding principal-open equation for (W,U) and (W,V); both values equal that of the single shared chart map φ_W. Sheaf separatedness (section_ext) on Q gives the equality over the full inverse image of V. Empty inverse images are handled by the same extensionality; n=0 by empty products and empty tuples.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ideal_wedge_selfTor_coordinates
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n
    let T := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    let c := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      selfTorConormalComparison (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    ∃ (s : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ ((T U).obj _).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
      (t : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((T U).obj _).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ Q.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)),
      let φ := fun U ↦ (s U).hom ≫ ((T U).map (c U)).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≫ (t U).hom
      let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
      let η := (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
        i.ker.toModules
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (b : Fin n → i.ker.toModules.val.obj (op V.1)),
        (φ U).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (i.preimage_mono h))))
            (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection N n (i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
              (fun j ↦ η.val.app (op V.1) (b j))) =
          (φ V).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1))))
            (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection N n (i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
              (fun j ↦ η.val.app (op V.1) (b j)))
